item.title: 全球首艘Jetfoil噴射船突遭拆解 關注組呼籲保留部分機件
item.description:
>
全球首艘Jetfoil噴射船突遭拆解 關注組呼籲保留部分機件 澳門博彩業早期極度依賴香港旅客跨海消費，而兩地主要的交通工具，是由已故賭王何鴻燊創辦的信德集團(242)旗下的噴射飛航。在眾多船款中，尤其以Jetfoil噴射水翼船最受港人青睞；該船型憑藉離水航行的獨特設計顯著降低搖晃感，能有效減輕暈船不適，甚至成為當時不少旅客指定搭乘的航線首選。 據民間網上組織「Jetfoil噴射船保育關注組」(下稱關注組) 表示，承載港澳兩地半世紀集體回憶、世界第一艘Jetfoil噴射水翼船「水星」，近日已被移往香港海洋造船廠先前拆解其他噴射船的位置，目前船體已遭拆除近一半。關注組接受訪問時對「水星」突遭拆解表達極度可惜與無奈，並呼籲船公司與相關部門能盡量保留部分具代表性的船身結構或機件，為港澳水上交通發展史留下見證。 「水星」是全球首隻 Jetfoil 噴射水翼船，船身編號001，由波音公司於1974年製造，起初命名為「Jetfoil One」，為波音公司的官方樣辦，接載全球準買家，包括後來成為全球最大Jetfoil用家的已故「賭王」何鴻燊。當時，何鴻燊創立的「澳門旅遊娛樂有限公司」旗下信德船務於1964年成立品牌「遠東水翼船」。後來何鴻燊在美國試乘Jetfoil後，隨即以每艘高達350萬美元（相當於同廠波音737客機三分之一造價）的重金購入兩艘，遠東水翼船亦因而成為後來全球最大的Jetfoil用家。 首艘「木星」於1975年4月25日投入服務，「金星」亦於同年8月加入。航線取得巨大成功後，遠東水翼船於 1978 年再從美國夏威夷營運者手上購入在當地短暫營運的「水星」、「火星」及「土星」，「水星」亦成為繼「木星」及「金星」後，第三艘投入來往港澳服務的 Jetfoil 噴射船。而在「水星」服務期間，亦承載著重要歷史記憶，1983年底被稱為「澳門王」的知名華人領袖何賢於香港出殯，其靈柩便是由「水星」運送回澳門安葬。「水星」一路營運至2008年退役，隨後一直停泊於荔枝角海洋造船廠；由於較早退役，它成為了船隊中唯一完整保留千禧年代白色為主塗裝的珍貴歷史樣板。 Jetfoil噴射水翼船在港澳交通史上扮演著不可或缺的角色。自1975年投入服務以來，該航線營運超過半世紀，高峰期有多達16艘同款船隻航行，是八九十年代澳門對外連接的世界橋樑。雖然隨著疫情後渡輪客量不復以往，船公司自2025年年中起陸續拆解了「銀星」、「天皇星」、「帝后星」、「木星」及「海皇星」等多艘同款船隻，但Jetfoil技術至今在日本等地仍十分活躍，川崎重工更於近年公布改良型號，足見其設計歷久不衰。 事實上，「水星」在2020年底就曾面臨拆解危機，當時在港澳兩地媒體報導與社會各界強烈呼喚下成功暫停。當時澳門海事及水務局曾表示高度重視，香港中西區區議會亦通過動議要求協調保留，連波音公司歷史部門也對拆解消息表達遺憾並期望能保留重要部件。關注組過去曾多次向澳門海事局及香港相關部門反映，雖當局過去曾表達一定關注意願，不料近日仍難逃拆解命運。 關注組表示，雖然「水星」因長期停航及零件共用，機件已難以重新運行，但仍希望社會各界能關注港澳海上交通遺產的保存。關注組亦提到，現時仍有其他狀況良好、具備航行能力的同類型噴射船，期望未來能繼續爭取復航或適當保存，讓這段獨特的港澳海運歷史得以延續。

item.title: 成本遠超收益 南韓江原樂園非博彩業務累計虧損1.7兆
item.description:
>
南韓江原樂園非博彩業務累計虧損1.7兆 南韓唯一容許本地居民入場的賭場江原樂園(Kangwon Land)，旗下飯店、渡假村及滑雪場等非博彩業務正面臨嚴重的結構性虧損。最新統計顯示，其非博彩業務累計虧損已逼近1.7兆韓圜(約98.35億港元)，引發外界質疑賭場經營所得並未有效用於南韓前煤礦區經濟，而是被長期虧損的非博彩事業大量消耗。 截至去年底，江原樂園旗下7項非博彩業務自開業以來的累計虧損已達1兆6,850億韓圜金，而博彩業務同期則高達15兆7,245億韓圜(約917.84億港元)的累計盈餘。江原樂園非博彩事業的赤字問題在疫情期間急劇惡化，2020年創下1,687億韓圜(約9.85億港元)的單年最大虧損紀錄，此後每年赤字均超過1,300億韓圜(約7.59億港元)。到了去年，原本唯一保持盈利的高爾夫球場事業也轉盈為虧，導致7項非博彩事業全數陷於赤字，全年總虧損額達1,474億韓圜(約8.60億港元)。 南韓國會預算政策處在最近發佈的報告中指出，江原樂園非博彩事業存在嚴重的結構性獲利缺陷。去年除角子機製造外的6項非博彩業務總營收僅1,834億韓圜(約10.71億港元)，但營運成本卻高達3,413億韓圜(約19.92億港元)，營運成本竟是收入的1.86倍。其中又以旗下皇宮酒店的成本超載最為嚴重，高達收入的3.11倍，滑雪場為2.36倍，水上樂園為2.30倍，公寓式渡假村則為2.19倍，高昂的固定成本讓各項業務完全入不敷出。 國會預算政策處強調，江原樂園當初獲特別批准經營本地人賭場，核心宗旨是為了振興前煤礦山地區的經濟發展，然而長期以賭場巨額利潤補貼非博彩事業虧損的結構，極大限制了資金回饋當地社區的能力。加上江原樂園目前正在推進名為「K-HIT」、預計至2035年投入約3兆韓圜(約175.11億港元)的大型投資計劃，若在現有非博彩業務盈利結構未改善前盲目投資，恐將進一步加重財務負擔。南韓議員具滋根對此表示，江原樂園必須對非博彩事業進行全面檢討，擺脫過度依賴賭場收益補貼的惡性循環，才能真正打造讓地方經濟自給自足的永續成長引擎。

item.title: Conservation Group Calls for Preservation of World’s First Jetfoil
item.description:
>
Conservation Group Calls for Preservation of World’s First Jetfoil The world’s first Boeing Jetfoil vessel, FLORES, which carries half a century of collective memories for people in both Hong Kong and Macau, has recently been moved to the spot where other Jetfoil vessels were previously scrapped in Hong Kong Ocean Shipyard, and nearly half of its hull has already been dismantled, according to Jetfoil Conservation Concern Group.     Macau’s gaming industry used to heavily rely on cross-sea visitors from Hong Kong in its early days, with TurboJET (operated by Shun Tak Holdings (242), founded by the late gambling tycoon Dr. Stanley Ho) serving as the primary transportation mode between the two cities. Among various vessel models, the Boeing Jetfoil was particularly favored by passengers. Featuring a fully-submerged foils design that allows the vessel to travel above the water surface to avoid waves and turbulences, it significantly reduced seasickness, making it the preferred choice for many travelers at the time.   In a recent interview, the Jetfoil Conservation Concern Group expressed regret over the sudden scrapping of FLORES, urging the shipping company and relevant authorities to preserve major structural parts or components to leave a lasting testimony for the maritime transit history of Hong Kong and Macau.   FLORES, launched in 1974 as JETFOIL ONE bearing hull number 001, is the very first of its kind. Manufactured by Boeing, the vessel originally served as the official sample for Boeing to demonstrate its leading technology to global prospective buyers, including Dr. Stanley Ho, who later became the world’s largest Jetfoil operator.   Far East Hydrofoil Co., Ltd., a brand under Shun Tak Shipping founded by Dr. Ho in 1964, was established to service the route. After test-riding the Jetfoil in the United States, Dr. Ho immediately acquired two vessels at a cost of US$3.5 million each (equivalent to one-third the price of a Boeing 737 passenger jet at the time), paving the way for Far East Hydrofoils to become the largest Jetfoil operator globally.   The first vessel, MADEIRA, entered service on 25th April 1975, followed by SANTA MARIA in August of the same year. Following the massive success of the line, Far East Hydrofoils purchased three more Jetfoils in 1978 (FLORES, Corvo, and Pico) which had briefly operated in Hawaii. FLORES thus became the third Jetfoil to enter the Hong Kong to Macau line after MADEIRA and SANTA MARIA. During her service, FLORES carried significant historical memories. After the funeral of the well-known Chinese community leader and “King of Macau” Ho Yin in Hong Kong in late 1983, FLORES transported his casket back to Macau for burial. FLORES retired in 2008 and remained laid up in Ocean Shipyard in Lai Chi Kok ever since. Due to her early retirement, she is the only Jetfoil in the fleet to keep the white-color livery from the 2000s in its entirety.   The Boeing Jetfoil has played an indispensable role in the transport history of Hong Kong and Macau. Operating on the route for over half a century since 1975, the fleet peaked at 16 vessels in its heyday, serving as a vital bridge connecting Macau to the outside world in the 1980s and 1990s. Although passenger volume failed to return to pre-pandemic levels after the pandemic, leading the shipping company to accelerate the scrapping of several sister vessels (SÃO JORGE, FUNCHAL, TAIPA, MADEIRA, and HORTA) since mid-2025, Jetfoil technology remains very active in places like Japan. Kawasaki Heavy Industries also announced a modified model in recent years, proving that the design remains timeless and competitive.   In late 2020, there was an initial attempt to scrap FLORES, but it was successfully halted following media coverage and strong public outcry in both cities. At the time, the Marine and Water Bureau of Macau SAR stated they were taking this seriously, the Central and Western District Council in Hong Kong passed a motion requesting coordinated preservation efforts, and even Boeing’s history department expressed sadness over the news and hoped significant parts could be preserved. Despite the Group having repeatedly raised concerns to Macau’s marine department and relevant Hong Kong authorities, and despite previous expressions of interest from officials, FLORES ultimately could not escape the fate of being scrapped.   The Group noted that while FLORES’s mechanical systems are no longer operational due to prolonged layup and cannibalization of parts, they hope the public and stakeholders will pay attention to the preservation of Hong Kong and Macau’s maritime transit heritage. The Group added that other Jetfoils in good condition and seaworthy state still exist, and they hope to continue advocating for their resumption of service or proper preservation, allowing this unique chapter of maritime history to be carried forward.

item.title: 黑兌夾雜千元偽鈔呃賭客 女換錢黨被捕移送法辦
item.description:
>
女換錢黨黑兌夾雜千元偽鈔被捕。 一名36歲無業王姓內地女子，涉嫌在澳門娛樂場從事俗稱換錢黨的非法匯兌活動，並在交易期間將一張印有「COPY」字樣的一千港元偽鈔夾雜在真鈔中交予賭客。事主其後持該批港元前往賭枱兌換籌碼時，被荷官當場揭發並驚動保安。娛樂場保安截獲涉案女子並移交警方處理。 司警於昨日(13日)凌晨2時許接獲路氹一間娛樂場的保安部通報，指場內有賭客以偽鈔兌換籌碼。調查發現，事主於當日凌晨1時許在場內與涉案姓王女換錢黨進行私人貨幣兌換，雙方協議以26,100元人民幣兌換20張1,000港元現鈔及1萬港元籌碼。 女換錢黨交付現金後離開，事主隨後持現金到賭枱兌換籌碼時被揭發夾雜偽鈔，保安隨即在場內截停王某。經檢驗該張1,000港元偽鈔紙質及造工粗糙，無水印、金屬線等防偽特徵，且鈔面印有「COPY」字樣。姓王疑人供稱該偽鈔是其早前在內地兌換貨幣時取得，並在輾轉交易中交予事主。 警方進一步調查顯示，姓王疑人自今年10月初起在澳門娛樂場從事不法匯兌，每兌換1萬港元可獲利100元人民幣，至今累計獲利400元人民幣。行動中，司警共扣押其涉案手提電話、22,700港元現金、7,500港元籌碼及涉案偽鈔作為證物。警方目前正進一步追查偽鈔來源，並以涉嫌觸犯將假貨幣轉手罪及經營為賭博的不法匯兌罪，將姓王女換錢黨移送檢察院偵辦。

item.title: 男子路氹酒店高處墮下送院搶救不治 司警跟進調查死因
item.description:
>
網上流傳一名男子疑從高處墮下躺於酒店大堂。(短片截圖) 澳門路氹城區一間酒店今日(14日)發生一宗懷疑高處墮下致命事件。一名男子於日間被發現倒臥在酒店大堂。網上流傳片段所見，男子躺在地上沒有任何動靜，十多名酒店保安人員在場維持秩序，等待警方和救護人員到達。據消息指，男子送院搶救無效身亡，澳門司警已接手調查，詳情有待官方公佈。 現場消息指，該男子疑於酒店5樓墮下至地面大堂，隨即失去意識。墮下觸發的巨響引起一陣騷動，保安人員迅速到場並報警求助。保安人員其後在現場拉起臨時封鎖線，疏導在場人士、維持大堂秩序。 消防救護人員接報趕抵現場後，隨即將男傷者送往醫院急救。澳門治安警與司警人員事後到場調查，封鎖相關區域並向現場人員了解事件經過。據最新消息指，該男子最終搶救無效不幸身亡。目前警方及相關部門尚未公佈事主的確切身份及墮下原因，事件定性及相關細節仍有待官方調查發佈。

item.title: Genting Shares drop 23% in Worst Loss Since 1998
item.description:
>
Genting Shares drop 23% in Worst Loss Since 1998 Genting Shares drop 23% in Worst Loss Since 1998 Shares of Malaysian gaming and entertainment conglomerate Genting plummeted by nearly 23 percent on Monday (October 12) following the announcement of a rights issue to raise approximately MYR 1.25 billion (HKD 2.4 billion) for debt refinancing and working capital, raising market concerns over equity dilution and financial strain. The company’s shares recorded its largest single-day loss since 1998, plunging 22.87% to close at MYR 1.45 (HKD 2.78), hitting a multi-decade low not seen in over 20 years. Trading volume surged to more than 90 million shares. Following an initial dive of over 15% from its reference price shortly after the market open, Bursa Malaysia suspended intra-day short selling (IDSS) in Genting shares for the remainder of the trading session. Short selling is scheduled to resume at 8:30 a.m. tomorrow. The sharp decline wiped out roughly MYR 1.67 billion (HKD 3.21 billion) in market value, shrinking the group’s market capitalization to approximately MYR 5.6 billion (HKD 10.75 billion) at close. In a regulatory filing with Bursa Malaysia last Friday (October 9), Genting outlined a proposed renounceable rights issue with an indicative issue price of MYR 1.30 (HKD 2.50) per share. The final issue price will represent a discount of 25% to 30% to the Theoretical Ex-Rights Price (TERP), calculated based on the 5-day volume-weighted average market price (VWAP). Of the expected proceeds, approximately MYR 800 million (HKD 1.54 billion) will be allocated to settle borrowings maturing within 12 months post-completion, with the remaining balance earmarked for general working capital. Based on the weighted average annual interest rate of 5.16% on short-term borrowings as of late June, the debt repayment is expected to generate annual interest savings of around MYR 41.3 million (HKD 79.3 million). As of June 30, Genting’s total borrowings stood at MYR 45.25 billion (HKD 86.9 billion), comprising MYR 9.68 billion (HKD 18.6 billion) in short-term debt and MYR 35.58 billion (HKD 68.3 billion) in long-term borrowings, carrying interest rates between 3.88% and 8.45% per annum. On the brokerage side, Maybank Investment Bank downgraded its rating on Genting over the weekend to “Sell,” lowering its target price to MYR 1.49 (HKD 2.86). Last Friday, Genting closed up 2.17% at MYR 1.88 (HKD 3.61) with a market capitalization of MYR 7.29 billion (HKD 14.0 billion). As of today’s close, the stock has accumulated a year-to-date loss of 51%.

item.title: 澳門首三季博彩稅收錄745.6億 達全年預算目標八成
item.description:
>
澳門首三季博彩稅收入達745.6億澳門元。  澳門財政局最新公佈的中央帳目資料顯示，2026年首三季澳門博彩稅累計收入約745.6億元(澳門元、下同)，較去年同期增長近5.9%，順利達成全年925.3億元預算目標的八成，執行情況良好。 單計9月份，澳門博彩稅收錄得近83.9億元，按月回升約7.2%，表現回暖，顯示博彩稅款依然是澳門公共財政經常收入的最主要來源。截至9月底，政府公共財政總收入近898.8億元，博彩稅佔整體收入近八成三，充分反映博彩相關稅收對政府財政穩健的顯著貢獻。 在開支與結餘方面，首三季澳門政府總開支為682.7億元，其中屬於經常開支的轉移、資助及補助項目按年增加10億元，微升2.6%。受惠於收入帶動，截至9月底的公共財政結餘達到216億元，較去年同期大幅增加三成，整體財政狀況保持非常穩健。 針對博彩市場的營運表現，澳門9月博彩毛收入錄得178.4億元，雖然按年微跌1.2%，但由於稅款入帳的時間性與當月毛收入統計屬於不同維度比較，因此單月稅收仍呈現環比增長，而前9個月累計5.9%的博彩稅增幅，則如實反映了今年以來的總體入帳趨勢。 對於澳門政府原先預測全年2,360億元的博彩毛收入目標，行政長官岑浩輝於本月10日明確表示暫無計劃作出調整。隨着進入第四季，接下來數月的博彩實際營運狀況與稅款入帳表現，將繼續成為決定本年度最終財政收入的關鍵因素。

item.title: Industry Experts Propose Strategies to Optimize Macao’s Visitor Base and Tackle Carrying Capacity
item.description:
>
Industry Experts Propose Strategies to Optimize Macao's Visitor Base and Tackle Carrying Capacity As Macao’s tourism market continues its steady growth, balancing visitor demographics with local carrying capacity has become a focal point for the industry. Industry leaders and experts interviewed by Allin noted that while Macao’s overall tourism sector remains healthy, it faces dual challenges: an influx of short-haul day-trippers from neighboring regions and the need to expand international visitor markets.   Looking ahead, Macao should further optimize its visitor demographic structure, enhance international flight connections, and strike a long-term balance between the supporting facilities of major integrated resort operators and the survival space of local small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).   Andy Wu, President of the Travel Industry Council of Macau, stated that the average hotel occupancy rate in Macao currently remains around 90%, with a balanced ratio between gaming visitors and overall tourists, reflecting a positive and healthy development trajectory. Looking back at the pre-pandemic Golden Week in 2019, when Macao had only around 30,000 hotel rooms, hotel rates skyrocketed to exorbitant levels, negatively impacting visitor experience. Today, the total supply of hotel rooms in Macao has expanded to approximately 46,000, bringing market supply and demand to a more stable equilibrium. Wu also pointed out that attracting visitors through direct flights straight to Macao would effectively help extend their length of stay.   Integrated Resorts as a Double-Edged Sword: Industry Expresses Concern Over SME Crowding-Out Effect Leveraging substantial capital and forward-looking strategies, major integrated resorts and gaming operators have developed comprehensive, one-stop leisure and entertainment ecosystems. However, Zeng Zhonglu, President of the Asia-Pacific Association for Gambling Studies, analyzed that while these facilities effectively attract tourist traffic, they may also crowd out the survival space of local SMEs and neighborhood businesses.   Nevertheless, Zeng emphasized their positive ripple effect as well. The massive local procurement scale of integrated resort operators actively stimulates the growth of local suppliers and manufacturers, driving local economic growth at the supply and production levels. Therefore, assessing the promotional role of gaming enterprises requires an objective analysis across different dimensions: while retail competition may exist, their contributions to the supply chain are significant.   Addressing the Day-Trippers: Experts Urge Quality Over Quantity In recent years, seamless transport links across Greater Bay Area cities (such as Zhuhai, Shenzhen, Zhongshan, and Foshan) have given rise to a large wave of day-trippers who do not stay overnight. Zeng analyzed that due to high-frequency travel from neighboring cities like Zhuhai, residents from these areas have a low inclination to stay overnight, visiting Macao primarily to stroll and sample local cuisine. He noted that such short-haul visitors make a relatively limited contribution to the overall economy and gaming revenues; their primary impact lies in boosting official visitor arrival statistics. However, an overwhelming influx of short-haul visitors may create a sense of overcrowding for high-end visitors, thereby reducing their willingness to visit Macao.   “In attracting tourists, Macao must prioritize quality over quantity,” Zeng suggested. Moving forward, the focus should shift toward attracting long-haul travelers from beyond Guangdong Province as well as family demographics. Family visitors have a significantly higher overnight stay ratio compared to non-family travelers, while long-haul travelers possess higher spending power and greater potential for longer stays—ultimately generating higher tax revenues and long-term economic benefits for the Macao government.   In summary, while maintaining steady growth, Macao’s tourism industry is actively shifting its focus from purely pursuing visitor numbers toward optimizing visitor structure and increasing overall carrying capacity, aiming to achieve a sustainable balance among community economies, integrated resort development, and tourism quality.
